I.value_en: English and Chinese READMEs, RC release notes, CHANGELOG, normative English spec abstract, ADR-0015..0022, ADR index, and existing tests.

O.value_en: Bilingual entry badges/nav/TL;DR/abstract, ADR-top TL;DRs, three ADR Accepted statuses with synchronized index, report/archive.

A.value_en: Use three commits to add bilingual core-entry content, ADR TL;DR/status/index, and run regression.

V.value_en: ADR-0015, ADR-0016..0022, TASK-008, RC framing, and the normative status of existing English spec.
